events.description: A white van enters the intersection from the left and collides with a silver sedan approaching from the front, causing the van to flip onto its side.

A high-speed rear-end or multi-vehicle collision occurs in the left lanes around 28.5–29.0s, producing a large dust/debris cloud and visible vehicle deformation; a dark SUV is seen spinning and coming to rest sideways by 31.5s.

A high-speed collision occurs in the left lane involving at least two vehicles, producing a large dust/debris cloud and scattering debris across the highway. A dark sedan is seen veering sharply left and impacting another vehicle or barrier, with visible smoke and parts flying.

Secondary collision or aftermath: a black SUV (possibly involved or newly entering) swerves violently, kicking up more dust; debris remains airborne and scattered on road surface. Another vehicle appears to spin or lose control near the initial impact zone.

Ongoing post-collision scene: multiple vehicles are stopped or moving slowly through debris field; one damaged car is stationary on left side, emitting smoke/dust. Traffic flow is disrupted, with vehicles maneuvering around wreckage and debris.

A severe multi-vehicle collision occurs on the highway, with visible vehicle deformation, debris scattered across lanes, and dust/smoke rising. A dark SUV is involved in a side or rear impact, and another vehicle (possibly a sedan) is seen spinning and heavily damaged on the left lane.

Immediate aftermath of the crash: vehicles are stationary or slowly moving away; debris remains on road; a white van enters frame from left, navigating around wreckage. The initial impact zone is still obscured by dust but clearly post-collision.

A motorcycle has crashed on the highway; the rider is lying on the road surface, and debris is scattered across multiple lanes. Vehicles are slowing and maneuvering around the scene. The motorcycle appears to be sliding or tumbling in frames f10–f15.
A dark-colored car veers sharply right off the road, collides with or near a building, and kicks up a large dust cloud; the scooter rider is ahead and unaffected.
A sudden, violent dust and debris plume erupts from the roadside building area coinciding with the vehicle impact, suggesting a secondary explosion or structural collapse triggered by the crash.
A black sedan collides with a motorcycle in the middle of the road, causing the car to spin and emit smoke/debris; parts fly into the air.
A blue truck is struck by a high-speed train at a railway crossing while the crossing signals are red; the impact violently displaces the truck.
